Three of the hand's main uses are touching/feeling (sensing texture, temperature and pressure), stroking, and lifting, throwing and writing. The team note says the correct answer is either "Touch, feel, stroke" or "Lift, throw, write," so either set works, and I'm going with "Touch, feel, stroke." I can't verify that "five main uses" is a fixed standard list, so this rests on the note.

CONFIDENCE: 60
